title: spartina stricta subsp. townsendii
intro: Spartina stricta subsp. townsendii, commonly known as saltgrass, is a type of salt-tolerant grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. Research has shown that saltgrass has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an antimicrobial agent and exhibiting hepatoprotective properties, which can help protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of saltgrass include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
